name: NV-Reason-CT

lineage.how_derived: native 3D vision encoder (Primus 3D ViT initialised from COLIPRI) plus the language model, trained end to end with SFT then GRPO on about 550,000 CT question-answer examples from 70,111 volumes

purpose: 3D vision-language model for CT: radiology report generation, question answering and multi-step reasoning over chest and abdominal volumes; research use, not for clinical decisions (card).

license.name: OpenMDW-1.1 (card tag)
license.notes: Same licence family as nemotron-3.5-parse, whose OpenMDW text was read; this repo's own LICENSE file was not opened. The card says the model must not be used for clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions.

architecture.kind: 3D VLM: 3D ViT turns a 384x384x384 mm volume into 24x24x24 = 13,824 visual tokens passed unpooled to a Qwen3.5-4B decoder with 3D MRoPE
